final_prompt:
I'm preparing a kickoff for engineering and design leads on a B2B note-taking app. They will use the PRD to decide whether and how to start work on adding team workspaces. The PRD should be about 2 pages, and your reply should be the PRD only.

Problem and evidence: I have no evidence to share, such as data or customer quotes. Include an "Evidence" section that says plainly this is a gap to fill before or during kickoff. Do not invent data, quotes, customer names, or statistics. State the problem in one or two lines, using only what follows from the scope below.

Scope in v1:
- Creating a workspace
- Inviting members by email
- Shared notes
- Two roles only: admin and member

Out of scope: billing changes, SSO, guest access.

Open question, to keep open: what happens to existing shared notes (migration). List it under Open questions with the decision it blocks, and the options if you can see them. Do not resolve it or assume an answer anywhere else in the doc.

Success metric: 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days. Use it as given. If you propose any further metrics, label each one "proposed".

Format: a standard PRD template, with these sections: Overview, Problem, Evidence (gap), Goals and success metric, Users and roles, Scope (in v1 and out of scope), Requirements for each in-scope item, Open questions, Risks and dependencies. Keep it to about 2 pages. Write for engineering and design leads, so make requirements concrete enough for them to estimate and to start design. Do not pad with generic filler.

Add a final short section called "Assumptions I made", listing anything you had to assume or fill in that the brief did not give. If there were none, say so. Nothing follows that section.
